✨ ULTIMATE LUXURY IN LIBERTY HILL! ✨
Wait until you see this masterpiece… EVERY. SINGLE. BEDROOM. has its own private en-suite bath! 🤯🛁

If you love entertaining and value privacy, this is the one you’ve been waiting for. Located in the highly desirable Liberty Hill area, this home is packed with high-end upgrades! 😍

Here is why you will fall in love:
🛏️ All En-Suite Bedrooms – Ultimate privacy for family and guests!
💻 Dedicated Home Office – Your perfect WFH sanctuary.
🍿 Private Media Room – Sunlit & separated by elegant French doors.
👨‍🍳 Gourmet Chef’s Kitchen – Massive island, walk-in pantry & seamless flow to the grand formal dining area. 🥂
🔥 Stunning Great Room – High ceilings & a modern electric fireplace for the perfect cozy vibe without the hassle!
👑 Primary Retreat – Soaring ceilings with a spa-like bath featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate shower. 🧖‍♀️
🌳 Entertainer’s Backyard – Covered patio, custom pergola, and a fire pit ready for Texas evenings! 🍷🔥

📍 Location: Liberty Hill, TX
